snippet.title: The indie game "Prism: Master Tape" is released!  Will be available on the Steam platform
snippet.description:
Prism: Master Tape is a dystopian soft sci-fi work. One day, you and your family received a flyer from the community to watch a movie for free. And your family had already left early, and you arrived later – only to find out that they weren't there. After that, you discover the untold secrets of the medium of "video".
[2025.02 Landing on Steam, store page has been opened]
